Added a test. Unfortunately it doesn't look like this fixes it

I pushed an alternative fix. When working in legacy mode, we have to consider the graph might be unstable – so we have to skip bailing out of work if its dirty (unfortunately) just in case a sub-dependency turns out to need scheduling.

I've come up with an alternative approach, and that is to treat all legacy effects as maybe dirty – thus by ensuring that all transitive dependencies that are dirty are visited are appropriately cleared up for future work.
Can't approve this because I've opened the PR, but looks good to me 👍

issue_context.title: Svelte 5 Reactivity issue with Svelte 4 code
issue_context.body: ### Describe the bug Repro: https://github.com/arackaf/svelte-5-reactvity-bug Run the app. You should see some colored boxes. As you hover over the colored boxes you should see the block of text slide around. Instead, the text will slide once, the first time you hover over a box. Then it'll "get stuck." You can refresh the page, and (carefully) hover over a different box. You'll see the text moves to a different location, and then get stuck. There's two ways you can fix this, which should hopefully help pinpoint where the bug is. Option 1: Go into the Content component, and swap these two renders out (comment out the first, uncomment the second) ``` ``` and then, obviously, uncomment this line ```ts // $: ({ x, y } = $currentState); ``` Refresh, and you should see everything working perfectly. Option 2 for fixing Git revert your changes, then go to Tooltip.svelte, and swap these two lines (comment out the first, uncomment the second) ```ts tooltipState.tooltipVisible(); // setTimeout(() => tooltipState.tooltipVisible()); ``` Refresh, and it should work again (and downgrading to Svelte 4 fixes it, as well) ### Reproduction https://github.com/arackaf/svelte-5-reactvity-bug ### Logs ```shell n/a ``` ### System Info ```shell System: OS: macOS 14.6.1 CPU: (16) x64 Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9980HK CPU @ 2.40GHz Memory: 235.40 MB / 16.00 GB Shell: 5.9 - /bin/zsh Binaries: Node: 20.10.0 - /usr/local/Cellar/nvm/0.38.0/versions/node/v20.10.0/bin/node Yarn: 1.22.22 - /usr/local/Cellar/nvm/0.38.0/versions/node/v20.10.0/bin/yarn npm: 10.2.3 - /usr/local/Cellar/nvm/0.38.0/versions/node/v20.10.0/bin/npm pnpm: 8.14.0 - /usr/local/Cellar/nvm/0.38.0/versions/node/v20.10.0/bin/pnpm bun: 1.0.36 - ~/.bun/bin/bun Browsers: Brave Browser: 127.1.68.141 Chrome: 128.0.6613.85 npmPackages: svelte: ^5.0.0-next.240 => 5.0.0-next.240 ``` ### Severity blocking an upgrade
comments: Still whittling this down but in the meantime [here's a somewhat simpler repro](https://svelte-5-preview.vercel.app/#H4sIAAAAAAAAE5VT2W6DMBD8lS2KFJCQyfVEAKn_0LemDxyO6hZsyzZJI8S_1wdHKlUtedxlZpadWXfemdRYevFr59G8wV7sPXPuhZ66cVPIC64V1rVkrShNJ5GlIFxlJ3pSpOFMKOhAqlxh6OEsWANrFNl6fbzDvDBWK8InxFAjN8BAk2hWpsmIv-R1i9NuZRWRrXqIHKZolWIUGI3LmpSfaecHkGbuZ5DEyt8GfbZNIofLljB2mrGbGLCEsteU_UNDDppxmBja3IZV5Exw5cVK6P3CKQvLmdP4kPdJTO4LnFeM1rcQroKovKjnKJy9Og8mXB60ZFQqsA1IJ4LfOadj2EAfWCD-svIj3gScQmcilW1hoio02uqgqRHaz3pFKxY4uO5YVMsrLeL7XOCLdUQPRQiZMnTT9Wg7W_VO6J1d_eUiM_tE--Nftg7H9fCZ_2_vkiehUYO3NVZu8aHtvC4Zv91H47wcIKsYyBlcD57SFDaTQYaHZvOPo2327KyVozs_nxrPupXh9knEf7nGt_4bkkrusSUEAAA=)

The problem is that the synchronous rerun of the store triggers the derived inside the property again, which is marked DIRTY, but then the logic inside `mark_reactions` bails because `reaction === current_effect`. That means the derived is never set to DIRTY, and in the subsequent run of `mark_reactions`, it then bails because the derived is already DIRTY, thus stuff is not propagated further.
Just curious, would this have worked if everything else was the same, but the store was replaced with a Svelte 5 Rune?

review_comments: Does this mean a `DIRTY` is reset to `MAYBE_DIRTY ` - on purpose? I'm not fully understanding the reasoning, which could be best adressed with a comment above the code
No, `CLEAN` is reset to `MAYBE_DIRTY`. Added a comment.
